# Data Integrity Checklist: Production Triage Outcome Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009F requirements define durable, typed, idempotent, and cleanup-safe routing evidence without duplicate active artifacts or unsafe persisted references.
**Created**: 2026-05-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Typed Artifact Integrity

- [ ] CHK001 Are all supported non-remediation outcomes mapped to exactly one typed lane artifact family and shared schema version? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK002 Are common envelope fields for source task, workspace, source issue, disposition, lane, routing status, rationale, recommended action, labels, evidence references, deferred side effects, and timestamp explicitly required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK003 Are lane-specific required fields documented for SpecKit handoff, clarification request, specialist recommendation/unassigned state, and closure recommendation outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006-FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is strict validation ownership defined before artifact publishing while preserving existing artifact storage responsibilities for persistence, redaction, size/MIME limits, supersession, and secret scanning? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]

## Source Identity And Idempotency

- [ ] CHK005 Is the canonical idempotency key specified with stable source-task, workspace, and disposition identity only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK006 Are source task identity gates documented so routing only records evidence for the intended Mission Control Issue Triage source tasks? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK007 Are same-outcome unchanged retries specified to create no new artifact or activity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK008 Are same-outcome changed retries specified to supersede the prior active artifact and keep superseded artifacts trace-only? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-025]

## Conflict And Partial Persistence Recovery

- [ ] CHK009 Is changed-disposition retry behavior specified as a visible conflict with no terminal artifact for the attempted outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK010 Are conflict activity fields constrained to sanitized existing disposition, attempted disposition, and idempotency key data? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications §Terminal State And Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK011 Is artifact publish failure specified to record sanitized failure evidence, omit the terminal recorded activity, and expose incomplete or unavailable route state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK012 Is retry recovery specified for an existing artifact with missing recorded activity without creating a duplicate active route artifact? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]

## Evidence Reference Safety

- [ ] CHK013 Are rationale, next action, question, closure, and evidence-needed strings bounded, normalized, and treated as untrusted inert display text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK014 Are safe evidence references typed and restricted away from raw bodies, logs, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, storage URIs, secrets, parser internals, actor identity, and PII-bearing key/value material? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 Is URL handling specified so query strings/fragments are stripped by default and active links require strict protocol and destination-family validation? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications §Lane Payload Contracts]

## Fixture Cleanup And Duplicate Evidence

- [ ] CHK016 Are UAT fixtures required to cover all six supported outcomes while asserting typed evidence, source task completion, and no remediation or non-remediation successor? [Coverage, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK017 Are disposable fixture rows required to be exported with inserted ids, cleanup scope, and post-cleanup zero counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable enough to prove exactly one current active route summary and zero remaining disposable fixture rows after cleanup? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-009]

## Verification Re-run

- [ ] CHK019 Are the typed payload requirements consistent across spec, data model, and contract artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Lane Payload Envelope]
- [ ] CHK020 Are idempotency and supersession requirements consistent between the source-task state clarifications and the Triage Route state model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024-FR-028, Data Model §Triage Route]
- [ ] CHK021 Are safe evidence reference requirements consistent with the prior task Evidence precedent for stored strings and active links? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Prior Spec §009E FR-038]
- [ ] CHK022 Are partial persistence failure requirements measurable without adding new tables or migrations? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK023 Are changed-disposition conflict requirements narrow enough to avoid terminal evidence for the attempted outcome while preserving auditability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Triage Route]
- [ ] CHK024 Are UAT fixture cleanup requirements traceable to durable review evidence rather than retained local rows? [Traceability, Spec §FR-037, Spec §SC-009, Constitution §Archive And Evidence Policy]
